Palette olive #7B7639, dark olive #58542A, ochre #C88F35, mustard #B58D3A, rust #83403C, plum #6E4764, mauve #8D6B84, pale mauve #B59BB8, lilac #9479B8, cream #E6D7BB. Each sprite must remain inside its original cell with generous transparent gutters. Decorative only, no logos or real people. Five sprites exactly as template: top-left museum display (rust plinth, pale mauve glass represented by a flat paper panel, olive/mauve/plum layered soil with a slim orange worm model); top-middle two cream speech bubbles with leaves and abstract bars, no writing; top-right arched mauve/lilac greenhouse with cream ribs, olive seedlings and plum soil; bottom-left rust T soil corer in plum soil mound, a small soil core and two cream soil sample bags; bottom-right small ochre magnifying glass with cream lens and rust handle.
